privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1.title: 1. Data Controller
privacy.section1.body: This site is a personal portfolio developed and operated by Amine Charrad, DevSecOps engineer.
privacy.section2.title: 2. Data Collected
privacy.section2.body: This site collects the following data:
privacy.section2.item1: Login data: email address and hashed password (BCrypt) when authenticating to the admin area.
privacy.section2.item2: Navigation data: IP address, browser, pages visited, timestamps — automatically collected in server logs.
privacy.section2.item3: Contact form: name, email and message if you use the contact form.
privacy.section3.title: 3. Purposes and Legal Basis
privacy.section4.title: 4. Hosting and Data Transfers
privacy.section4.body: This site is hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS), region eu-west-3 (Paris, France). All data is processed within the European Union, with no transfer to third countries.
privacy.section5.title: 5. Cookies
privacy.section5.body: This site uses only a technical session cookie, strictly necessary for the admin area to function. This cookie does not require your consent.
privacy.section5.note: No tracking, advertising or third-party analytics cookies are used.
privacy.section6.title: 6. Data Recipients
privacy.section6.body: Your data is neither sold, assigned, nor rented to third parties. Technical processors are: AWS (hosting), Amazon SES (email sending).
privacy.section7.title: 7. Your Rights (GDPR)
privacy.section7.intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
privacy.section7.right1: Right of access: obtain a copy of your personal data
privacy.section7.right2: Right of rectification: correct inaccurate data
privacy.section7.right3: Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")
privacy.section7.right5: Right to data portability: receive your data in a structured format
privacy.section7.right6: Right to object: object to the processing of your data
privacy.section7.contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at: amine.charrad@gmail.com. We will respond within one month.
privacy.section7.cnil: You may also lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority in your country.
privacy.section8.title: 8. Data Security
privacy.section8.intro: Technical and organisational measures are implemented to protect your data:
privacy.section8.m1: Encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS via Let's Encrypt)
privacy.section8.m2: Encryption at rest (AWS RDS AES-256 encrypted)
privacy.section8.m5: Secrets managed via AWS Secrets Manager
privacy.section8.m6: Automated security audits (OWASP ZAP, CodeQL, Trivy)
privacy.section9.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
privacy.section9.body: This policy may be updated. The date of last modification is shown at the top of this page.
